guards.what: THIEVERY's four steal-priority predicates drop four clauses
guards.issue: LIVE. ThievingHopper.cs:31-69 defines `_stealPriorities` as four predicates, tried in order; the first that matches anything narrows the candidate set. thieving_hopper.py:68-76 transliterates them and loses one clause from each: (1) C# tier 1 is `!(c.Enchantment is Imbued) && Rarity == Uncommon`; the sim is `rarity == UNCOMMON` -- the Imbued exclusion is gone. (2) C# tier 2 is `!Imbued && Rarity in {Common, Rare, Event}` (ThievingHopper.cs:43-46); the sim is `{COMMON, RARE}` -- **Event is missing**. (3) C# tier 3 is `!Imbued && Rarity in {Basic, Quest}` (:62-64); the sim is `{BASIC}` -- **Quest is missing**. (4) C# tier 4 is `Rarity == Ancient || c.Enchantment is Imbued` (:68); the sim is `rarity == ANCIENT` -- the Imbued alternative is gone. Observable: a different card is stolen, permanently, from the run deck. Concrete case -- a deck whose draw+discard piles hold no Uncommon, one Event card and one Basic: the game narrows to the Event card at tier 2 and steals it; the sim finds nothing at tier 2, narrows to the Basic at tier 3 and steals a Strike instead. LIVE on both sides (rule 6): the sim's CardRarity (cards/base.py:22-32) has EVENT and QUEST and the ported set holds 19 EVENT cards (cards/event_cards.py, cards/trash_heap_cards.py, cards/mad_science.py) and 3 QUEST cards (ByrdonisEggCard, LanternKeyCard, SpoilsMapCard), all deck-addable by ported events; ImbuedEnchantment is ported (enchantments.py:243-253) and is granted by the ported relic Electric Shrymp (relics/electric_shrymp.py:17-21), so an Imbued Uncommon -- the exact card the game protects from theft and the sim does not -- is obtainable. Third-file citations (cards/event_cards.py, relics/electric_shrymp.py) not hashed here.
